blocks.x: There’s never been a better time to escape the monotony of day-to-day life and venture out to an unexplored horizon. Whether you’re looking to spend a couple of days on the beach sipping cocktails at an all-inclusive resort or want to wander through the streets of Barcelona, taking in the history, a great place to start planning your trip is on the platform Agoda.

From booking flights to comparing hotels and selecting activities, Agoda makes it easy to plan nearly every aspect of your trip in one place (unfortunately, you’ll have to pack your bags all by yourself). My favorite aspect of the website? The incredible filter options. They have all the regular filters—property types, payment options, star ratings, facilities, amenities—alongside some total game changers, like the ability to filter for distance to popular attractions (hello, Eiffel Tower), by fan-favorite hotel brands like Marriott and Hilton, and by neighborhood.

There are plenty of ways to save—and bundle—on Agoda for your adventure around the world. Read on for all the best Agoda promo codes, discounts, and coupons to stretch your budget as far as it can go. Looking for even more options? Take a gander at our promo codes for Expedia and Booking.com coupons. Plus, once you get there, browse our Viator discounts on activities in the area.
Download the app for a 10% Agoda coupon code to use on your first booking

Starting off strong, first-time users can score an Agoda promo code for 10% off their first booking when they download the app and make a purchase. To ensure you get your savings, scan the QR code that pops up on the Agoda homepage with your phone for an instant discount. Discounts are valid on your entire first purchase, including hotels, flights, and activities. Whether you’re on your way to a relaxing staycation for a few days or planning a multi-week Southeast Asian jaunt, this is how to start your trip on a high note.
Visit the deals hub for Agoda promo codes offering up to 30% off this fall

If your trip plans aren’t set in stone, consider keeping them flexible and taking advantage of Agoda’s plethora of sales and promo codes. Scroll through their deals hub for ever-changing discounts, including Agoda coupons for up to 5% off select hotels, 8% off other hotels, 15% off Eco Deals at select resorts, and up to 30% off international hotel rates.

Simply visit the hub, click on a code, and it will be added to your account, letting you scroll through countless options before it's applied at check-out. For more flexibility, you can head right to the hotels, activities, and flight bundles pages for the city you’re visiting, and you’ll see discounted codes in red as you browse. Download the app to store all your codes, offers, and discounts in a user-friendly way.
Save more on flights, hotels, and activities with AgodaVIP

Sign up to be an AgodaVIP to save even more. The loyalty program is completely free to join, and helps you save on (and track) all your future trips. New users will start on the Bronze tier, followed by the Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond tiers. To move up tiers (and reap more rewards), all you have to do is complete a certain number of bookings. Higher tiers mean better, more exclusive perks, like free breakfast, VIP deals of up to 25% off, and priority customer support, but members of all tiers get access to Insider Deals.

Travelers can also find a list of the ever-changing VIP flash sales on Agoda’s platform, where you can easily input your travel dates as well as the region you’re interested in heading to, then scroll through the hundreds of savings options. Right now, for example, you can enjoy up to 25% off hotels around the world, from Lisbon and Rome to Tokyo and Marrakech.
What to do if your Agoda promo code isn’t working

If your Agoda promo code isn’t working, there are a few troubleshooting methods you can try to secure your savings. First, make sure that you applied the right code and typed it in correctly, paying special attention to capitalization and spaces. The next step is to check the discount code's details and restrictions: confirm that your booking meets minimum spend requirements, the code isn’t expired, that you’re using it on an eligible item, and anything else in the fine print. Once you’ve run through all of the above steps, consider clearing your browser’s cache and cookies or switching browsers to fix the problem. If all else fails, contact Agoda’s customer service for specialized help.
